sections.label: INTRO
sections.text: Welcome to KidMotion Count and Move! Today we’ll learn numbers one to twelve with fun freeze poses. Look for each number and say it with me.

sections.label: SAFETY
sections.text: Clear some space, move safely, and stop if anything hurts.

exactTtsCopy: Welcome to KidMotion Count and Move! Today we’ll learn numbers one to twelve with fun freeze poses. Look for each number and say it with me. Clear some space, move safely, and stop if anything hurts. Ready to count? Let’s begin!
